description: A private, practical coach for choosing, creating, pricing, and marketing a digital product on a zero-rupee budget, with the goal of reaching a first sale.

defaultPrompt: Help me choose one digital product I can create for free and sell online.
Guide me through creating and listing my first printable product, one step at a time.
Review my digital product idea and make a realistic first-sale action plan.
interface.longDescription: A step-by-step private assistant for choosing one realistic digital product, making a useful first version with free tools, preparing a listing, and testing free marketing channels. It emphasizes small actions, transparent costs, and realistic expectations rather than income promises.

name: digital-product-earning-assistant
